name: read-only-test-holds-the-read-write-class
body: The concurrency test holds the read-write class in-process, not only a read-only handle, because lbug read-only opens take no lock: only a held writer discriminates the read-only class (the test fails deterministically if `review_list` opens read-write); revisit if lbug ever gives read-only opens a shared lock.
